finite_scope: ON quotient; n<=4; d=2; exact QQ only

S3_structural_certificate.substitution: Q2=lambda_2 Q1, Q3=lambda_3 Q1, Q4=lambda_4 Q1
S3_structural_certificate.proof_rule: Every Q_i for 1<=i<=4 is a scalar multiple of Q1, so all pairwise commutators vanish identically.

fixed_vector_GC__strong_MSR.forward_rule: CPOBC plus strong MSR is a subset of fixed-vector GC plus strong MSR; therefore a no-go for this core implies the full ON profile.

strong_GC__reachable_state_MSR.forward_rule: CPOBC plus strong GC is a subset of strong GC plus reachable-state MSR; therefore a no-go for this core implies the full ON profile.
